items.title: Show HN: A lightweight mapping editor for improving MTB trails on OpenStreetMap
items.contentSnippet:
I wanted to share a lightweight mapping editor I’ve built to make it easier to improve MTB trail data on OpenStreetMap. In general MTB trails on OSM could be greatly improved, especially when it comes to IMBA ratings and I wanted to lower the barrier to entry to contributing to OSM.
Key features:
* Load satellite, lidar or OSM GPS traces to verify trail paths
* Dedicated keybindings for quickly tagging a trail's IMBA rating and other actions
* Add, edit and split trails to improve trail accuracy
